title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.39382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Textual skills provide reusable guidance for large language model agents, but existing approaches often rely on manually curated skill banks or reinforcement learning with indirect and delayed feedback. We introduce SkillFM (Skill Flow Matching), a generative framework that synthesizes task-conditioned textual skills directly without test-time skill retrieval. Our framework combines a codec for encoding and reconstructing textual skills in a continuous latent space with a conditional flow model trained using improved MeanFlow. At inference time, the learned velocity field enables single-step latent sampling, and an LLM-based decoder converts the sampled representation into textual guidance for a frozen downstream agent. We evaluate the framework on embodied tasks, question answering, and web shopping. On ALFWorld and Search-QA, our method achieves the best overall performance among the compared vector-based skill approaches. Our analyses

translated_title: SkillFM：通过潜空间流匹配为大型语言模型智能体生成技能
translated_abstract: 文本技能为大型语言模型智能体提供了可复用的指导，但现有方法通常依赖于人工整理的技能库或带有间接且延迟反馈的强化学习。我们提出了SkillFM（技能流匹配），这是一个生成式框架，可以直接合成以任务为条件的文本技能，无需在测试时进行技能检索。我们的框架将一个用于在连续潜空间中编码和重构文本技能的编解码器，与一个使用改进的MeanFlow训练的条件流模型相结合。在推理时，学习到的速度场支持单步潜空间采样，随后由基于LLM的解码器将采样得到的表示转换为文本指导，供冻结的下游智能体使用。我们在具身任务、问答和网购任务上对该框架进行了评估。在ALFWorld和Search-QA上，我们的方法在所比较的基于向量的技能方法中取得了最佳的整体性能。我们的分析……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SkillFM提出了一种无需测试时技能检索的生成式框架，通过编解码器将文本技能编码到连续潜空间，并利用改进MeanFlow训练的条件流模型直接合成任务条件化的文本技能，在ALFWorld和Search-QA等任务的基于向量的技能方法中取得了最佳整体性能。
